title: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Sensex settles 905 pts higher, Nifty ends above 22,900; Adani Ports, Kotak Bank top gainers
summary: Sensex, Nifty, Share Prices Highlights: Sensex closed 905.01 pts or 1.24% higher at 74,151.04, and Nifty 50 gained 237.90 pts or 1.05% to 22,936.75 on Thursday as midcap index outperformed and ended at day’s high. Realty, FMCG and PSU Bank led the sectoral gainers. Only auto and cement dipped.

score_reasons: -5 Market commentary rather than a company development
direction_reasons: No clear directional signal in the available text
WAAREEENER.why_it_matters: This reaches the company indirectly via its customer exposure to Adani. The parts of the business most likely touched are pricing, input cost, customers. Classified as commodity.
